title: Less Grind
description: Aims to make the game less grindy overall
body:
# Less Grind
_Make Minecraft less grindy and time consuming!_

Changed crafting recipes to give more items!  
Changed ores to give more items!  
Increased drop rates for `ender pearls` and `wither skulls`!  
More Villages and rare structures!

Saddles are now craftable  
Tridents are now craftable  
You can smelt whole Raw Ore blocks to save some time  

Fishing gives double loot!  

Added some handy crafting recipes like chainmail armor, mud, sand and cobweb  
**You can see all the recipes in the Gallery**
